new: Self hypnosis is extremely powerful, and when you are in an altered state of consciousness, whether it be from loveyhuasca, or meditation, or when lucid dreaming, or from grief, or sexual energy, or prayer, or not sleeping, or any other way similar to using plant medicines, often you can get your mind to open faster then your adult self can figure out what is going on.

old: This guide doesn’t tell anyone to use substances. It does acknowledge that many people first encounter self-hypnosis, inner-child contact, or Higher Self dialogue while altered.
Do not use altered states to force revelation. Use them to deepen listening, strengthen love, and improve ordinary life.

A past opening can be a resource without becoming a state you must reproduce. Having experienced love once, being able to access it only in a particular state, and contacting it reliably in daily life are different things. Let the experience widen what seems possible while you build usable access. If the child cannot receive it, meet the difficulty rather than escalating the intensity.
During or after an altered state, these prompts are usually more useful than demanding a revelation:
“Help me stay grounded.” “Help me receive only what I can integrate.” “Help me remember love.” “Help me return when it is time.” “Help me translate this into one ordinary-life change.”
Don’t use self-hypnosis to prolong an altered state indefinitely, recover memories, intensify fear, bypass sleep, override medical needs, or make yourself less able to communicate.
If the state makes you less loving, less grounded, less honest, less able to sleep, less able to communicate, or less able to meet ordinary responsibilities, stop deepening and start integrating.
new: NB: I am NOT saying to use these. But a lot of people try these for the first time while under the influence.
Also if you DO use these, remember that you don't want to force it in that state, but help you in your regular life.

Also if you HAVE used these in the past and opened something, remember that it is different to have it in that state, then to have it in your regular life. It is great that it opened, but if the child isn't able to take it in, rather than turning the tap on more, you want to say things like: "Help me to ground". "Help me to only take that which I can take in". "Help me to remember love". "Help me to come back when the time is right". "Help me to take one change into my regular life".

Don't use self hypnosis to: Keep you in that state forever Make memories come up Make you afraid to do things Make you not sleep Do anything that your body needs you not to Do Make you not talk to people

If you are doing any of these, while you are in the altered state of consciousness and it is helping you NOT to love/ground/be honest/sleep/talk/regular life, then you need to stop trying to get to the next level and work on incorporating what you have into your life.
